regions.name: Borneo
regions.quote: Nemacheilus spiniferus is a nemacheilid loach from Borneo, recorded from Sarawak, Brunei and Kalimantan, plus the Natuna and Anambas islands.

regions.name: Kapuas River
regions.quote: Has been recorded throughout much of the Malaysian state of Sarawak, plus the Kapuas River system in the Indonesian province of Kalimantan Barat (West Kalimantan) and the Malinau River drainage in Kalimantan Timur (East Kalimantan) province, Borneo.
